capabilities: Record and revoke verification events in frontmatter
Set and clear lifecycle status (draft, stable, deprecated)
Set stale-after review dates via picker or day presets
Add or remove configured frontmatter attributes on a note
Color and decorate file explorer entries by review state, with a toggle
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition note reviewer; it tracks document verification and lifecycle status in frontmatter.
extras: Not in the community plugin store; requires manual installation by copying the folder into .obsidian/plugins/ and enabling it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a document's review state (who verified it, when it goes stale) in frontmatter or surface that state in the file explorer.
summary: Review side panel for OKF-format notes that records verification events, lifecycle status, and stale-after dates in frontmatter.
